Fourth Year Anniversary

We've come such a very long way together. Four years filled with hardships, challenges, growth, and love. Through everything we've faced, we've continued to choose each other. It fascinates me how we watched each other grow. Choose paths of our own. Gets separated but still bounded. I want you to be the one I am with till the end of times. And this is only the beginning; our journey will continue until the end of time, through this lifetime and into eternity.

I love you so, so much. Always and forever.

With love,
Rheinheart
